_comment: All relative paths in this file are resolved relative to this file's directory. Intended default location: config/pipeline.json alongside config/tool_paths.json.
_comment_output_dir: Shared output directory for all runs in this batch
_comment_keep_ir: Set to true to keep all intermediate IR files for debugging (applies to all runs)
_comment_run_name: Optional: Name for batch output folder (defaults to 'batch'). Used when keep_ir is false.

runs._comment_config: Optional: override hardware config file path (auto-resolved from T/B by default)

runs._comment_custom_config: Example: Use a custom config file for this run
